findings.passage: We call on you to act on the following pieces of reasonable and responsible legislation and appropriations. These measures do not infringe on Second Amendment rights, nor on the ownership of firearms by responsible individuals:
findings.note: Letter to the legislative leaders after the Uvalde and Buffalo shootings, signed by 18 Senate caucus members including Saval (listed as Senator Nikil Saval, 1st Senate District). It asks for action on SB 88, SB 134, SB 217 and related bills. A caucus letter, not his alone.
subjects: gun safety laws and Second Amendment rights

findings.passage: Senate Bill 88 – This legislation eliminates most of the exceptions to the requirement of a background check prior to the purchase or transfer of a firearm.
findings.note: Same caucus letter signed by him: asks leaders to act on a bill widening background checks on gun sales and transfers.

findings.passage: Senate Bill 134 – This bill provides for extreme risk protection orders to keep firearms out of the hands of individuals with documented evidence of potential to harm themselves or others.
findings.note: Same caucus letter signed by him: asks leaders to act on the extreme risk protection order bill.

findings.passage: Senate Bill 217 – This bill provides for required reporting of lost and stolen weapons to local law enforcement with 24 hours of recognition of the event.
findings.note: Same caucus letter signed by him: asks leaders to act on a lost-and-stolen gun reporting bill.
